skills.name: enter_standby
skills.description: Enter private standby when the user clearly wants conversation paused until recalled; Hey Jarvis or Hello Jarvis resumes. Use for explicit standby, sleep, mute yourself, directed goodbye, or don't speak until I call you. A bare mute means Jarvis standby, never system audio or microphone mute. Interpret keep quiet from context; clarify unclear scope. Do not use for stopping only the current reply, corrections, brief pauses, quoted phrases, or questions about standby. Background tasks continue.
